svg.title: Graceful drain versus fault abort and retained native ownership
svg.desc: Normal stop cancels startup and silence, releases inputs independently, then drains the transport before accepting terminal finals. A fault closes admission and aborts. A timed-out native release remains owned and prevents restart.
